recommendedSyncArchitecture.sourceCode: GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket or another approved Git remote
recommendedSyncArchitecture.projectSpecifications: Commit this laptop-off folder to the project repository or sync it through approved cloud storage
recommendedSyncArchitecture.cloudConversations: Use Cloud Work for conversations that must continue across web, mobile and desktop
recommendedSyncArchitecture.codingTasks: Use Codex Cloud for cross-device cloud coding tasks, or Remote access to the host where a local task is running
recommendedSyncArchitecture.secrets: Configure per laptop through a secret manager or secure local credential store

syncNotes: This is a portable specification/index, not a copy of Codex internal storage.
Project paths are preserved as source references and may need remapping on another laptop.
Use the chat title, project path and summary to rehydrate context in a new Codex chat.
Local Codex chats and local task state are not automatically copied to every laptop.
Do not place passwords, API keys, tokens, certificates or production connection strings in this manifest.
